title: Creative Designer (m/w/d)
description:
Dich begeistern Creatives, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern skalieren? Du willst von grafischer Seite unmittelbar daran mitwirken, dass ein Onlineshop wächst – und in den Zahlen sehen, was dein Hook, dein Static, dein Banner bewegt? Dann bist du bei NEOLYMP richtig. Wir skalieren unseren Shop, und ein großer Teil davon entscheidet sich im Creative. Genau da sitzt du: als Creative Designer:in, der oder die aus Design- und Grafiksicht maßgeblich an unserer Performance mitwirkt.

Wer wir sind

NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir über Amazon und unseren eigenen Onlineshop.

Content ist bei uns der Motor: Wir bauen unsere Inhouse-Creative-Produktion konsequent aus – mit echten Shootings, einem Creator-Netzwerk und KI-gestützten Workflows. Unser Grafikteam wächst, und wir suchen jemanden, der das gesamte visuelle Spektrum abdeckt.

Warum diese Rolle

  • Du bist Teil der Performance: Deine Creatives laufen im Paid-Marketing und entscheiden mit, wie profitabel wir skalieren. Du siehst in den Zahlen, welcher Hook funktioniert, welches Static klickt – und drehst mit jeder Iteration an einem Hebel, der direkt auf Umsatz wirkt.
  • Alles aus einer Hand: Video-Creatives, Statics, Social-Content, Shop-Banner, Produktbilder – du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles Visuelle und siehst deine Arbeit überall: in Ads, im Feed, im Shop.
  • Bestes Rohmaterial: Du arbeitest mit Content aus echten Shootings und von echten Creatorn – kein Stockmaterial, sondern Persönlichkeiten und Produkte, die du in Szene setzt.
  • Grafikteam statt Einzelkämpfer: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen, die Grafik, Content und Creator verantworten, und eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen.
  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz: Du nutzt KI-Tools, um schneller zu Varianten und Ideen zu kommen – und entscheidest als Designer:in, was davon gut ist.

Aufgaben

Performance Creatives

  • Du schneidest Video-Creatives für Meta, TikTok und weitere Paid-Kanäle – vom Rohmaterial aus Shootings und Creator-Content bis zum fertigen Ad, inklusive Hook-Varianten, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Du gestaltest Static Ads, die in Sekunden verstanden werden, und entwickelst sie auf Basis der Performance-Daten iterativ weiter.
  • Du setzt Briefings aus dem Performance-Team um und bringst eigene Ideen für Formate, Hooks und Varianten ein.

Social Media & Organic Content

  • Du produzierst Grafiken, Reels-Schnitte, Story-Formate und Carousels für unsere organischen Kanäle – konsistent im Look, angepasst an jede Plattform.
  • Du entwickelst Templates, die dem Content-Team schnelle, markenkonforme Veröffentlichungen ermöglichen.

Shop, Amazon & Brand

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für alle Bannerbilder, Kampagnen-Visuals und Shopbilder – von Landingpage-Headern.
  • Du hältst unser visuelles Erscheinungsbild über alle Kanäle konsistent und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter.

Produktion & Workflow

  • Du integrierst KI-Tools in deinen Workflow – für Ideation, Bildvarianten, Freisteller, Übersetzungen oder Schnitt-Unterstützung – und teilst mit dem Team, was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Schnitterfahrung: Du beherrschst Videoschnitt sicher – Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve oder vergleichbar – und lieferst aus Rohmaterial eigenständig fertige, plattformgerechte Video-Creatives inklusive Schnittrhythmus, Text-Overlays, Untertiteln und Sound.
  • Bildbearbeitung & Grafik: Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma oder vergleichbare Tools sind dein Handwerkszeug. Freisteller, Retusche, Composings, Layouts und saubere Exportformate für Web, Social und Amazon gehen dir leicht von der Hand.
  • Ein Portfolio, das beides zeigt – Video und Static.

Das ist uns außerdem wichtig

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Grafik-, Motion- oder Creative Designer:in, idealerweise im E-Commerce, D2C oder in einer Performance-Agentur.
  • Ein Verständnis dafür, was Performance Creatives von schönen Grafiken unterscheidet: Hook, Klarheit, Tempo, Lesbarkeit auf dem Handy.
  • Gespür für Social-Plattformen: Du weißt, wie Content auf TikTok, Instagram und Pinterest aussehen muss, um nicht weggewischt zu werden.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du jonglierst mehrere Aufträge parallel, hältst Deadlines und behältst den Überblick über Formate, Versionen und Assets.

Das zählt für uns am meisten

  • Lust darauf, wirklich das ganze visuelle Spektrum zu bespielen, Neugier auf neue Tools und die Motivation, mit der Rolle und dem Team zu wachsen. Das Handwerk setzen wir voraus – für alles darüber hinaus ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools in der Bild- oder Videoproduktion (z. B. Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs).
  • Fotografie- oder Kamera-Erfahrung für Shootings.
  • Kenntnisse in Shopify (Bildformate, Theme-Assets) oder Amazon-Bildrichtlinien.
  • Erfahrung im Fitness- oder Sport-Umfeld.

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt unter „außerdem wichtig“? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert dein Portfolio und wie du denkst – nicht, ob du jede Zeile abhaken kannst.

Benefits

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest überwiegend remote und profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die dir eine eigenverantwortliche Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags ermöglichen. Zu Shootings triffst du das Team vor Ort – der Rest läuft von dort, wo du am besten arbeitest.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Neben moderner Hardware und den Tools, die du brauchst, erhältst du eine Spenditcard mit monatlich 50 € steuerfreiem Sachbezug sowie ein persönliches Educational Budget für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.
  • Verantwortung & Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst das visuelle Erscheinungsbild einer wachsenden Marke und gestaltest den Aufbau unserer Inhouse-Creative-Produktion aktiv mit – inklusive KI-basierter Workflows.
  • Dynamisches Startup-Umfeld: Freue dich auf kurze Entscheidungswege, regelmäßige Team-Events und ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – und darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Kontakt: Josephine Steuer

Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Bei uns gibt es keinen Dresscode und wir duzen uns einfach. Der Einfachheit halber verwenden wir im Text eine Sprachform, schließen damit aber ausdrücklich alle Menschen ein.

title: Brand Designer, Web
region: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re looking for a Brand Designer to join the Figma Brand Studio and focus on designing for the web. This role will help up-level some of our most important surfaces—our marketing websites—in brand-forward, novel, and unexpected ways.

This role sits at the intersection of web design, software storytelling, and brand. You’ll need expert visual and UX instincts, a deep curiosity about our products, and a point of view on how to make product stories land on the web—showing what Figma can do, not just telling. You’re someone who loves to tinker and experiment. You have a deep understanding of accessibility, and you’re comfortable taking ideas from early sketch to working prototype, partnering with web engineers to bring new patterns and interactions to life. Working closely across Brand and Marketing, you’ll shape everything from site structure and navigation to launch, campaign, and event experiences. You’ll also help evolve the web design system that helps the team ship quality work at speed. You’ll play a central role in defining how Figma shows up on the web through experiences that are inventive, accessible, and beautifully crafted.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Own and drive best-in-class UX and visual design across Figma’s marketing websites, from concept through prototype and production
  • Tell Figma’s software story on the web in compelling, inventive ways, working with Product Marketing and Content Strategy to show (not just tell) what our products can do
  • Prototype and develop new web patterns and interactions that move past standard SaaS conventions, and partner with web engineers to make them real
  • Design brand-forward web experiences for launches, campaigns, and events that feel novel and unexpected, while staying accessible and performant
  • Shape site structure, information architecture, and navigation to better bring our content strategy to life and serve customers’ needs
  • Evolve and contribute to our web design system, including templates and components that help the team ship quality work at speed
  • Share learnings, experiments, and techniques with Brand Studio and partners to raise the bar across the org

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years designing websites, with a portfolio that shows creative range, strong visual, interaction, and typographic craft, and a clear point of view on telling software stories on the web
  • Fluency designing, prototyping, and building with Figma, and curiosity about new design, build, and AI tools, with clear opinions on how and when to use them
  • Strong systems thinking, grounded in information architecture, UX and accessibility best practices, and experience contributing to and evolving design systems and templates
  • Experience using research and data to run experiments and drive decisions
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to drive concepts from start to finish on your own, partnering closely with design, copy, strategy, engineering, product marketing, and growth along the way
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity/expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to accommodations-ext@figma.com. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities.

Examples of accommodations include but are not limited to:

  • Holding interviews in an accessible location
  • Enabling closed captioning on video conferencing
  • Ensuring all written communication be compatible with screen readers
  • Changing the mode or format of interviews

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired you will be required to attend in person onboarding.

By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with Figma's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Application limits: To help candidates focus on the opportunities most relevant to their skills and experience, Figma limits the number and frequency of applications. These limits apply to all roles:

  • Candidates may submit up to 5 applications during any rolling 30-day period.
  • Candidates may not reapply to the same role while an application is active or within 90 days of receiving a rejection.

Once the applicable days has passed, candidates are welcome to apply again.

title: Graphic Designer I
description:
About us
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our people
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

Who You Are:

You’re a brand designer with a strong focus on print and editorial, and you enjoy bringing brands into the physical world. You think beyond the screen, considering how a design will translate to a 20-foot vinyl wrap, event signage or printed piece. You’re equally comfortable supporting digital work, from social templates to landing page graphics, and you apply strong design fundamentals across every touchpoint. You’re curious, proactive and detail-oriented, digging into problems and catching the small things that make a big difference in the final execution.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Designing large scale print materials including event signage, vinyl wraps, window wraps and booth design for hosted and sponsored events

  • Producing print marketing materials such as flyers and signage that stay on brand and print ready

  • Preparing print ready files with correct bleed, trim, color mode and vendor specs across InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop

  • Supporting layout and design work in Figma as needed to keep print and digital brand consistent

  • Contributing to new brand initiatives from concepting to launch

  • Partnering with the events and marketing ops teams to understand space, scale and install requirements before finalizing designs

  • Coordinating with print vendors and reviewing proofs to catch issues before they become expensive mistakes

  • Applying HighLevel brand guidelines consistently across every physical and print touchpoint

  • Taking feedback on assigned projects and applying it quickly to keep production timelines on track

What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, this is the most important skill for this role

  • Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

  • Working knowledge of Figma

  • A portfolio that shows real print production experience, not just digital mockups of print pieces, digital branding samples are a plus

  • Understanding of print fundamentals including bleed, trim, color profiles, file setup and vendor requirements for large format printing

  • Comfort moving between print and light digital branding work without missing a beat

  • Sharp attention to detail, you catch the small things before they turn into big and expensive problems

  • A curious, hands on problem solving mindset, you want to understand how something gets built and installed, not just how it looks in a file

  • Ability to work independently on problems of limited scope while learning to apply company standards and processes

  • Comfortable receiving direct feedback and iterating quickly

Experience/Education/Certifications Required:

  • 1-3 years of professional design experience, internships and apprenticeships included

  • Bachelor's degree in graphic design, visual communication or a related field preferred, equivalent experience and a strong portfolio will be considered

  • Required portfolio showcasing print and editorial design work, large format or event based work and digital branding samples

  • Ability to balance speed, creativity, quality and business priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • High attention to detail and commitment to producing polished, professional content.

  • Based in Mexico
